newsitem.title: USA: Sun plans work on Pennsylvania cat cracker.
newsitem.headline: Sun plans work on Pennsylvania cat cracker.

text.p: Sun Co Inc said it is planning a 44-day maintenance shutdown starting Oct 4 of the 85,000 barrel per day (bpd) catalytic cracking unit at its Marcus Hook, Penn., refinery.
In a prepared statement, the company said several related units will also undergo scheduled maintenance at the 175,000 bpd Marcus Hook refinery.
Among those units at Marcus Hook is the 80,000 bpd crude distillation unit, which Sun will also pull off line on Oct 4, but only for 18 days, the company said.
Separately, Sun will start a 21-day maintenance shutdown of the 28,000 bpd reformer at its separate 307,000 bpd Philadelphia refinery beginning Dec 1, the company said.
Sun said the cat cracker at Marcus Hook makes up less than half the cat cracking capacity at the Marcus Hook and Philadelphia refineries.
It also noted total crude distillation capacity at the two refineries is 482,000 bpd.
Additionally, it said the reformer at the Philadelphia refinery makes up less than 25 percent of the two-refinery system.
The company also said it already made arrangements to keep its customers supplies with gasoline and distillates during the turnarounds.
